reason: TurboVLA removes the LLM-centered V-to-L-to-A path for robot control and replaces it with a compact V+L-to-A policy. It reports 31.2ms policy latency and 0.9GiB VRAM for 0.2B parameters on RTX 4090, but studies robotic VLA inference rather than improving LLM inference/serving; retain as an adjacent boundary case.
title: TurboVLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Model at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with <1 GB VRAM
